primary.title: RBI revives FCNR(B) swap window for NRIs; can it replicate the 2013 inflow boom? Explained
primary.summary: The RBI has revived the FCNR(B) swap window, a tool last used during the 2013 rupee crisis. Here's how the scheme works and whether it can attract fresh dollar inflows from NRIs.
